articles.title: Rahul Gandhi’s Pellet Gun Dharna | CJP Team Attacked in Rajasthan | BJP Row Explodes | News18
articles.description: A major political confrontation is unfolding across Delhi and Rajasthan. Congress leader and Lok Sabha Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi staged a dharna at Parliament Street Police Station on August 21, demanding registration of an FIR over alleged pellet-gun injuries suffered by 19-year-old Sahil Lochab during the CJP-led July 20 protest. Gandhi accompanied Lochab to the police station after earlier efforts to get an FIR registered did not succeed.The Delhi Police has said that the Crime Branch is already probing complaints connected to the July 20 incident and that Lochab’s complaint would also be forwarded for investigation. The police have denied allegations that pellet guns were used against protesters, while Congress continues to demand accountability.Meanwhile, a separate political controversy has erupted in Rajasthan after CJP co-convenor Ashutosh Ranka and other CJP members alleged that they were attacked while visiting a government school in Rampura Kanwarpura, Jaipur, as part of the party’s “School Thik Karo” campaign. CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke alleged BJP-linked involvement and claimed vehicles were damaged. Villagers have disputed those allegations, adding another layer to the controversy.
